findings.remaining_action: This closes the adjudication/refresh half of RT-16 (can now ask the venue about ONE order it suspects is ambiguous or stale) AND now feeds ReconciliationScheduler's own, already-correct escalation policy with real MEDIUM-severity divergences. STILL NOT DONE, as a deliberate scope decision made and verified this session: ConsistencyChecker is NOT wired up, because it has three separate, compounding problems that would need fixing together, not patched individually -- (1) _get_active_tenant_exchanges() returns a hardcoded empty list, so it currently checks nothing; (2) _get_exchange_positions() calls get_or_create_exchange with no credentials and calls fetch_positions(), the wrong ccxt method for a spot-only platform; (3) _handle_mismatch() trips a GLOBAL kill switch on ANY mismatch, with no severity gating at all (unlike ReconciliationScheduler's own correct, already-scoped policy). Wiring real tenant data through (1) and (2) while (3) still halts the whole platform on any noise would risk a false-positive global halt; fixing it properly needs all three addressed together with sandbox verification, which is out of scope for this pass. Also still open: no private order/fill stream is consumed anywhere, so a fill the watchdog never suspected is still invisible; execution_records are still marked COMPLETED on venue accept rather than on a confirmed fill; real sandbox certification against a live exchange remains EXTERNAL_BLOCKED (no sandbox credentials available this session), estimated 40-80h remaining by the original audit even after both fixes in this session. _get_active_tenant_exchanges() DELIBERATELY still returns [] -- enumerating real tenant/exchange pairs today, even with the three fixes above, is not safe: PositionModel (the LOCAL side of this comparison) has NO WRITER anywhere in the live/paper trading execution path (backend/position_engine.py's PositionEngine is fully built but has zero callers -- grep confirms it) -- so every tenant holding any real exchange balance would register a permanent, structural MISSING_LOCAL finding on EVERY check, forever, flooding the very reconciliation_mismatches table this session just made useful via OrderWatchdog. On top of that, PositionModel.side is long/short -- a derivatives model that does not fit this platform's spot-only, always-non-negative exposure model (RT-21's own finding on BotRunner.recovered_exposure_coins). Enabling this for real needs (a) PositionModel actually wired into the live order path (a separate, nontrivial change touching the order path, not something to bolt on under this pass) and (b) a deliberate design decision on how a spot balance maps to a long/short-shaped position row -- both out of scope here and documented, not silently dropped, in _get_active_tenant_exchanges's own docstring.

findings.title: Sign-out does not revoke the caller's session
